snapshot.title: Mining tutorial pre-step: show mine zone before firing
snapshot.description: Testers don't know what mining means before they do it. Add a coach overlay frame before the fire step that highlights the mine zone and gives a one-liner explanation.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Tutorial shows mine zone highlight before player fires for the first time
